verdict.rationale: Meltano's project-as-code model (meltano.yml, plugins defined as code) explicitly supports version control and code review as part of DataOps best practices, and idempotent `meltano add`/CLI commands make config changes trackable in git (meltano-docs-18, meltano-docs-24, meltano-docs-33). However, there is no explicit built-in 'rollback' feature or UI for reverting pipeline runs—rollback would rely entirely on external git operations, which isn't documented as a first-class Meltano capability. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/undo mechanism for pipeline configs or runs, evidence of a review workflow (PR/approval) beyond generic git use, and independent corroboration of this workflow in practice.
